clauses.reason: Terminated by express revocation. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 12397, whose subject line describes continuing the National Commission on Social Security Reform. The single sentence amends section 2(b) of Executive Order 12335, which established the National Commission on Social Security Reform, so that the Commission makes its report to the President by January 15, 1983. Under owner ruling 2026-10-21 (report deadlines, option C) a report deadline is not an end: the command is functionally spent when the Commission reports, but the order remained on the books until this revocation. The actual report date is not recorded as a later event because no report text is among this packet’s citable evidence. Executive Order 12402 of January 15, 1983 (the held Federal Register text has its number misread by character recognition as 12432; the date, subject, amended section and the table of EO 12553, which lists 12402 after 12398, identify it) further amended section 2(b) (before: report by January 15, 1983; after: report by January 20, 1983); under owner ruling 2026-10-21 that is a strike-and-insert amendment, the clause continues, amended, and the substance (the report date) changed. Executive Order 12534 of September 30, 1985 (held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12534.txt; not among this packet’s citable evidence) revokes the parent order 12335 but does not name this order; under owner ruling 2026-10-21 (unnamed instruments) it is a disclosed candidate earlier end for the reviewer and not an end, and it is not recorded as a later event. No earlier express end was found.

It moves the report date of the National Commission on Social Security Reform. Inventory: one amending sentence, confirmed against the full held text. Ending: Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 12397, whose subject line describes continuing the National Commission on Social Security Reform. Executive Order 12402 (1983-01-15) is a later event, not an end.  The packet’s number-citation lookup over the held order texts (33,118 readable files) found citations of this number outside its own printings only in a held Wayback capture (web.archive.org) of a Social Security Administration history page for the Report of the National Commission on Social Security Reform (jobs/source-ladder/output/texts/queue_EO_12335_Date_the_National_Commission_on_Social_Security_Reform_EO_12335_submitted_its_report__05ec610361.txt), whose contents list Executive Orders 12397 and 12402 as modifying the reporting date and which says the Commission's report was issued in January 1983; that page recites the order and does not revoke, supersede or amend it.
